normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every accepted row pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of short residual cue words in every static color-script payload. Accept only bounded greeting-list copy or separable request, freebie, date, provenance, and production metadata proven by complete-panel and historical evidence; retain titles, identities, attribution, dedications, authored dialogue or captions, functional interfaces, structural text, seasonal greetings, and ambiguity.
